summary: Iter38 (frontend only): tested the theme migration in initTheme (v2) and the blue look, on WebKit with iPhone 13 emulation (390px). The service worker was blocked and each preset ran in a fresh context. Result: 18/19 checks pass. The one failure is expected: it is the Verde Classico swatch colours shown in the Profilo theme picker. Migration: (a) empty storage -> blu-italserrande; (b) verde-classico + theme_blu_v1=1 -> blu-italserrande; (c) verde-classico with no flags -> blu-italserrande; (d) notte-blu stays notte-blu. theme_blu_v2='1' is set in every case. Choosing Verde Classico in Profilo afterwards persists across reload and navigation (no forced re-migration), and switching back to Blu also persists. Visual check: Nuovo lavoro = rgb(11,46,102) navy, Esegui oggi = rgb(0,71,171), active bottom tab Prossimi is blue, the appointment chip is light blue with a blue border. A computed-style scan of all visible elements on /prossimi-lavori, /da-preventivare and /agenda found no remaining green or terracotta colours (#4A5D23, #B8683D, #3C4B1C, #3C4C1C, #2E5A47, #9F5630, #F9F8F6). The Profilo picker lists Blu Italserrande first.

ui_bugs.component: SezionaleRilievoDialog.jsx lines 305 and 343 (not rendered in this test; found by code review)
ui_bugs.issue: Under blu-italserrande, the substring rule [class*="bg-[#4A5D23]"] also matches 'bg-[#4A5D23]/10' and 'bg-[#4A5D23]/15'. These tinted backgrounds become solid #0047ab. At line 305 the text is also forced to #0047ab (text-[#4A5D23]), so the selected chip would show blue text on a blue background and be unreadable. Fix: switch to [class~="bg-[#4A5D23]"] and add rules for /10 and /15 tints (e.g. #e8f0fb).

design_issues.screen: Blue theme leftovers (code review; these did not appear in the visible views tested)
issues: Terracotta tint bg-[#F8EBE4] has no blu override: WeekView.jsx:223, Agenda.jsx:31 and 399, ClientSearch.jsx:128, ClientFormDialog.jsx:575.
Green tint bg-[#E5EFE9] has no blu override: Agenda.jsx:384, Incassi.jsx:201.
Beige bg-[#EAE7DE] (AppShell.jsx:67, Profilo, Spese, the dialogs) and bg-[#FBF1DE] remain warm beige.

Tinted border variants border-[#2E5A47]/20, border-[#B8683D]/20 and /30, and border-[#4A5D23]/30 and /40 are caught (or missed) by substring rules inconsistently. The ~= rules for B8683D do not catch /20 or /30.
[class*="text-[#4A5D23]"] also matches 'hover:text-[#4A5D23]' (18 uses), so those links are always blue, not only on hover.

action_items: Change [class*="bg-[#4A5D23]"] to [class~=...] in the blu-italserrande rules and add rules for the bg-[#4A5D23]/10 and /15 tints (SezionaleRilievoDialog would otherwise show blue text on blue).
Add blu overrides for bg-[#F8EBE4], bg-[#E5EFE9], and optionally bg-[#EAE7DE] and bg-[#FBF1DE], plus the /20, /30 and /40 border tints.
Production iPhone: the fix only arrives once SW v23 activates. Confirm sw.js calls skipWaiting/clients.claim so the installed PWA picks up the new bundle without a manual reopen.
critical_code_review_comments: initTheme v2 logic is correct and idempotent. It only migrates when the theme is empty or verde-classico, then sets the flag before applying, so later manual choices are kept.
applyTheme writes agenda_theme on every call. That is fine, but an invalid saved theme is silently replaced by blu.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of requested checks (18/19; the one failure is the expected Verde swatch in the picker)

seed_data_creation: Ephemeral Firebase user plus 2 TEST_iter38 clients. All were deleted at the end.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run `python /app/tests/iter38_theme.py` (WebKit, iPhone 13, service_workers=block). It covers the migration presets a-d, the persistence of a Verde choice, and a computed-colour scan per page for old green/terracotta hex values.
